# Rakitsu tested build: v0.3.2 (09c37a8e)
name: Evidence-checked brief
version: "1.0"
description: Turn source notes into a short brief and have a second agent flag unsupported claims.
settings:
  default_provider: ollama
  providers:
    ollama:
      type: ollama
      base_url: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1
      default_model: qwen3:4b-q4_K_M
  defaults:
    temperature: 0
    max_tokens: 1400
agents:
  - name: Drafter
    role: worker
    system_prompt: Draft three short bullets from the supplied evidence. Preserve all counts.
    settings: { max_iterations: 1 }
  - name: Checker
    role: worker
    system_prompt: Check the draft against the original notes. Return a corrected brief under a heading called Evidence brief. Explicitly mention the missing control group.
    settings: { max_iterations: 1 }
orchestrator:
  name: Recipe
  strategy: Pipeline
  agents: [Drafter, Checker]
  pipeline:
    steps:
      - name: drafter
        agent: Drafter
        task: Draft three short bullets from the supplied evidence. Preserve all counts. /no_think
      - name: checker
        agent: Checker
        task: Check the draft against the original notes. Return a corrected brief under a heading called Evidence brief. Explicitly mention the missing control group. /no_think
